annotations.title: Write to my agent in China

description: Prepares a message to their agent in China, a person on Rabbit’s team: a product search the catalogue does not find, a check before shipping, a question on an order, or goods on the warehouse photos that are not what they ordered. The card shows the message as it will leave; they send it from the card.

by_when.description: A new search: by when, in their words.

country.description: The country, as a two-letter code (US, FR, GB…); their account’s if omitted.

last_photo.description: Attach the photo they just sent to Rabbit.

message.description: The message, in their words, no contact details and no product reference (that goes in `product`).

not_as_ordered.description: true when the goods on the warehouse photos are not what they ordered (another product or model, wrong quantity, damaged): nothing ships, their agent reviews the photos with them.

order_id.description: With `not_as_ordered`: the order whose goods, seen on the warehouse photos, are not what they ordered.

photo_or_link.description: A new search: an https photo or product page.

product.description: The product reference returned by Rabbit (starts with “p”).

quantity.description: A new search: the number of pieces.

request_id.description: To follow up on an existing request (its number).

name: write_to_my_agent
title: Write to my agent in China
